subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should the 13 action upgrades be approved as one grouped trust-boundary update after the exact-head privileged checks complete, or should credential-bearing action families be reviewed separately?
rationale: These pins replace executable third-party code in workflows with GitHub App keys, registry credentials, security-upload permissions, and OpenAI credentials; CI can establish behavior but cannot make the repository's trust decision.

options.title: Approve the stable grouped head
options.body: Review the upstream action changes and merge the exact SHA only after every affected privileged gate completes successfully.

options.title: Split credential-bearing upgrades
options.body: Separate token, Docker publishing, and Codex-agent action changes if owners cannot confidently approve the grouped trust expansion as one unit.

recommendation.title: Approve the stable grouped head
recommendation.body: Review the upstream action changes and merge the exact SHA only after every affected privileged gate completes successfully.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to central CI and Docker release workflows affected by the grouped update.
